title: Attachment.
officialText: Fasteners for wood shakes shall be corrosion resistant with a minimum penetration of ¾ inch (19.1 mm) into the sheathing. For sheathing less than ½ inch (12.7 mm) in thickness, the fasteners shall extend through the sheathing. Each shake shall be attached with a minimum of two fasteners.
